build_system: tsc via npm scripts, no bundler
test_framework: Node built-in test runner via `npx tsx --test src/*.test.ts`
verification_instructions: Run `npm run typecheck` to validate types compile cleanly. Run `npx tsx --test src/*.test.ts` for unit tests.
environment_constraints: Network available for npm installs. No AWS credentials available so cannot run integration tests. Verification is type-checking only.
contribution_requirements: ESM modules with .js extension imports. TypeScript strict mode. All new features default off. Graceful degradation pattern. Tools return {content: [{type:'text', text: JSON.stringify(...)}], details: {...}}. Git push with --no-verify.
key_patterns: Tool factories: createXxxTool(client, config, getActorId, ...) returning {name, label, description, parameters, execute}. Config: resolveConfig(env, raw) merges env > raw > defaults. Client wraps AWS SDK BedrockAgentCoreClient. Module-level state variables. Service lifecycle via api.registerService({start, stop}). CLI via api.registerCli(). Hooks: api.on('before_prompt_build'), api.on('agent_end').
directory_structure: src/ - main source: index.ts (plugin entry), client.ts (AWS SDK wrapper), config.ts (config resolution), scopes.ts (namespace logic), identity.ts (session parsing), noise-filter.ts, adaptive-retrieval.ts, score-filter.ts, file-sync.ts. src/tools/ - 8 tool files (recall, store, forget, correct, search, stats, episodes, share). tests/ - test directory. skills/ - OpenClaw skills. docs/ - documentation.
